sources.scope: room height and beams above door openings
sources.note: Door opening beams may be at the height required for doors; do not impose ordinary 2.3m beam-underface guidance as universal door-head height.

sources.scope: brick/block masonry opening lintels in this general works specification
sources.note: Does not establish an independent projecting concrete beam for every opening in every structural system.

valueRole: authored design parameter, not uniform Hong Kong leaf height or actual surveyed building measurement
rule: floor datum -> clear passage / installation interface -> opening head -> identified supporting head region or unknown support -> storey upper boundary; no duplicate independent lintel when existing member already serves the role
